static_dataset.description: Authoritative, rarely changing policy corpus (ground truth for RAG answers).

records.text:
Title: Company Password Reset Policy

Employees must reset their company passwords through the official company password portal.

Employees must use their registered mobile number or the approved verification method to complete the reset process.

If an employee cannot access the registered mobile number, the employee must contact the IT Helpdesk for assistance.

Employees must never share their passwords with colleagues, IT support staff, or any other person.

If an employee suspects that a password has been compromised, the employee must reset the password immediately and notify the IT Helpdesk.
records.title: Company Password Reset Policy

records.text:
Title: Company VPN Troubleshooting Policy

Employees who cannot connect to the company VPN must first check whether their internet connection is working.

Employees must verify that they are using the approved company VPN application.

If the VPN application displays an authentication error, employees should verify their company login credentials.

Employees must not share their passwords with IT support staff.

If the VPN connection still fails after these checks, employees must raise an IT Helpdesk ticket.

The ticket should include the error message, the time of the failure, and the troubleshooting steps already attempted.

Employees must not disable company security software to make the VPN connection work.
records.title: Company VPN Troubleshooting Policy

records.text:
Title: Company Application Access Policy

Employees who require access to a company application must submit an access request through the approved IT service portal.

The request must include the employee's name, the application name, the business justification, and the required access level.

The employee's manager must approve the request.

Access is granted only after the required approval and security checks are completed.

Employees must not use another employee's account to access an application.

If access has not been granted after approval, the employee should contact the IT Helpdesk with the request reference number.
records.title: Company Application Access Policy
